{"type": "answer_plan", "interpretation": "Answer to: Break down MRR by plan.", "sql": "SELECT p.plan_name, COUNT(*) AS active_subscriptions, SUM(s.mrr) AS total_mrr
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN plans p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id
WHERE s.status = 'active'
GROUP BY p.plan_id, p.plan_name
ORDER BY total_mrr DESC"}
